description: Hand-transcribed NOAA/NOS March 2007 tables archived in XTide Appendix B, Comparison with published tables (copied 2007-02-24). Each negative-speed lull lies between two stronger ebbs without intervening slack. NOS subordinate minimum times apply the ebb maximum offset (-59 minutes), not minimum-before-ebb (-18 minutes). Speeds are published to 0.1 knot; this is an event-table reduction oracle, not harmonic prediction. Both stations use the same Pacific time offset.
